services.name: Interior painting
services.text: Living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, ceilings, trim and accent walls, with color and finish consultations.

services.name: Exterior painting
services.text: Full home exteriors, including siding, trim, doors and shutters, with surface prep and primer.

services.name: Cabinet refinishing
services.text: A kitchen transformation without a full remodel, with durable topcoats built for daily use.

services.name: Deck staining and fence refinishing
services.text: Premium stains and sealers that protect outdoor wood from Florida sun, rain and humidity.

services.name: Pool deck coatings
services.text: A surface that stays cooler, resists slipping and holds up to UV, chlorine and foot traffic.

services.text: Cracks, holes and damaged texture repaired, matched to your existing finish and painted to blend.
